sources.title: Beast Rider — Official Final Fantasy d20

issues.reason: Starting mounts refer to external druid-style companion rules. The archive has no verified canonical pony/wolf/camel/horse selection and progression for this archetype. Do not substitute FFd20 Beastmaster’s different full-BAB d10 companion table. A mount/eligibility/persistence adapter is required before activation.

Nine later parent targets are not yet canonical features in the current first-level Chocobo Knight definition. Source names and timing are retained without invented IDs; later replacement graphs must be resolved before those levels can be enabled.

Mount weight capacity, four-legged/no-fly restrictions, conditional combat effects, size changes, Endurance and combat training remain manual source rules. Structural staging is not independent approval or runtime support.

features.name: Able Rider
features.description: At 1st level, a beast rider ignores the penalty to Ride checks for riding ill-suited mounts.

features.name: Steed
features.description:
At 1st level, a beast rider forms a bond with a strong, loyal companion that permits him to ride it as a mount. The animal chosen as a mount must be large enough to carry the beast rider (Medium or Large for a Small character; Large or Huge for a Medium character). The beast rider does not take an armor check penalty on [Ride](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/skills/ride) checks while riding his mount. The mount is always considered [combat trained](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/skills/handle-animal#TOC-Combat-Training-DC-20-), and begins play with [Endurance](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/general-feats/endurance-final) as a bonus feat.

Each time the beast rider increases in level, he can choose to select a new, more impressive mount better suited to his increased power.

Small-sized beast riders can choose a [pony](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#pony) or [wolf](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#wolf) mount at 1st level. At 4th level, a Small beast rider can also choose an [allosaurus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Allosaurus), [ankylosaurus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Ankylosaurus), [arsinoitherium](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Arsinoitherium), [aurochs](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Aurochs-Bison-), [bison](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Aurochs-Bison-), [boar](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#boar), [brachiosaurus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Brachiosaurus), [elephant](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#elephant), [glyptodon](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Gylptodon), [hippopotamus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Hippopotamus), [mastodon](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#elephant), [megaloceros](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Megaloceros), [riding dog](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#dog), [giant snapping turtle](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Snapping-Turtle), [triceratops](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Triceratops), or [tyrannosaurus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Tyrannosaurus). At 7th level, he can also choose a dinosaur ([deinonychus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#deinonychus-velociraptor) or [velociraptor](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#deinonychus-velociraptor)).

Medium beast riders can choose a camel or horse mount at 1st level. At 4th level, a Medium beast rider can also choose an [allosaurus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Allosaurus), [ankylosaurus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Ankylosaurus), [arsinoitherium](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Arsinoitherium), [aurochs](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Aurochs-Bison-), [bison](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Aurochs-Bison-), [brachiosaurus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Brachiosaurus), [elephant](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#elephant), [glyptodon](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Gylptodon), [hippopotamus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Hippopotamus), [lion](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#cat-big-lion-tiger), [mastodon](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#elephant), [megaloceros](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Megaloceros), [giant snapping turtle](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Snapping-Turtle), [rhinoceros](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Rhinoceros), [tiger](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#cat-big-lion-tiger), [triceratops](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Triceratops), or [tyrannosaurus](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/animal-companions#TOC-Tyrannosaurus) as his mount. Additional mounts might be available with GM approval.

In addition, a 7th-level or higher Medium beast rider can select any creature whose natural size is Large or Huge, provided that creature is normally available as a Medium-sized animal companion at 7th level (like a bear). To generate statistics for such a mount, apply the following modifications:

* **Size** Large
* **Ability** **Scores** Str +2, Dex –2, Con +2;
* Increase the damage of each of the mount’s [natural attacks](http://www.d20pfsrd.com/bestiary/rules-for-monsters/universal-monster-rules#TOC-Natural-Attacks) by one die size.

A beast rider cannot choose a mount that is not capable of bearing his weight, that has fewer than four legs, or that has a fly speed (although the GM may allow mounts with a swim speed in certain environments). Anytime a feat or ability allows a mount to make a hoof attack, it can make a claw, slam, or other analogous attack instead.

This ability replaces chocobo mount.

features.name: Rugged Steed
features.description:
At 2nd level and every four levels thereafter, the natural armor bonus of a beast rider’s steed increases by +1.

This ability replaces steadfast mount.

features.name: Colossus Hunter
features.description:
At 3rd level, a beast rider gains a +1 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against Large and Huge creatures and a +2 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against Gargantuan and Colossal creatures.

This ability replaces knight’s charge.

features.name: Rapid Straddle
features.description:
At 4th level, a beast rider can make Ride checks to fast mount or fast dismount her steed even if it’s more than one size category larger than her, provided she still has a [move action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#move) available that round.

This ability replaces expert trainer and master feeder.

features.name: Undaunted
features.description:
At 7th level, a beast rider adds her Strength bonus to the DC of Intimidate checks made against her. Additionally, creatures attempting to intimidate a beast rider don’t gain a bonus for being larger than her.

This ability replaces improved chocobo mount.

features.name: Combined Might
features.description:
At 11th level, a mounted beast rider strikes with the combined power of herself and her steed. Once per round, when the beast rider hits with a melee attack from astride her steed during a charge, she adds half her steed’s Strength modifier to the damage roll in addition to her own, provided her steed is currently capable of taking a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free).

This ability replaces greater charge.

features.name: Gigantic Steed
features.description:
At 15th level, a beast rider’s steed increases to Huge size. The creature receives a –1 penalty on attack rolls and to AC, and a –2 penalty to Dexterity (to a minimum of 1); its base damage increases by one size category; and its reach increases to 10 feet. It also gains a +2 size bonus to its Strength and Constitution. At 17th level and 19th level, the Strength and Constitution bonuses increases by an additional +2.

This ability replaces superior chocobo mount.

features.name: Pulverizing Assault
features.description:
At 17th level, if a beast rider is mounted on her steed and directs it to charge or use a constrict, powerful charge, or trample attack, then the first time that her steed deals damage with this attack this round, the target must make successful a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of the steed’s Hit Dice + the steed’s Strength modifier) or be staggered for 1d4 rounds.

This ability replaces erratic charge.

features.name: Lord of Beasts
features.description:
At 20th level, a beast rider is unaffected by the dazed, fatigued, shaken, sickened, staggered, and stunned conditions. If she succeeds at a Fortitude or Will save against an attack that has a reduced effect on a successful save, she instead avoids the effect entirely. If a beast rider and her steed both successfully hit an opponent on the same initiative count, the foe must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of the steed’s Hit Dice + the steed’s Strength modifier) or be stunned for 1 round. Whether or not the save is successful, an affected creature is immune to this ability for 24 hours thereafter.

This ability replaces supreme charge.
